svg.title: AI Procurement Negotiation Agent architecture
svg.desc: Ingestion and retrieval pipeline through Hindsight Cloud memory and Groq, plus the write path and read path.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vendor history is stored in Hindsight Cloud memory and recalled into a Groq prompt to produce a negotiation briefing.
